g.title: N1 | sic_micro_prior_setting_degree Newly infected agent prior same-setting contact degree Scale: micro | Phenomenon: setting_infection_clustering Definition: For each event row e in events with run_id r, step t, agent_id a, layer L, classified as an infection transition by a fixed observed event_type/state label set, define D(e)=# { p : p is non-null/non-sentinel, p!=a, and exists c in contacts with c.run_id=r, c.layer=L, c.step in [t-W,t-1], and ((c.agent_id=a and c.partner_id=p) or (c.partner_id=a and c.agent_id=p)) }. The indicator value for e is D(e). W is a pre-specified nonnegative integer window length. g.title: N2 | sic_meso_layer_infection_contact_ratio Layer-specific infection events per contact edge Scale: meso | Phenomenon: setting_infection_clustering Definition: For run r, layer L, window [s,s+W-1], let I(r,L,s)=# { e in events : e.run_id=r, e.layer=L, e.step in [s,s+W-1], e classified as an infection transition }, and C(r,L,s)=# { c in contacts : c.run_id=r, c.layer=L, c.step in [s,s+W-1] }. g.title: N4 | icts_micro_quarantine_contact_ratio Agent contact-degree ratio around quarantine onset Scale: micro | Phenomenon: intervention_contact_trajectory_shift Definition: For each event q in events with run_id r, step s, agent_id a, state matching the observed quarantined label, before=false, after=true, let P_pre={p: exists c in contacts, c.run_id=r, c.step in [s-W,s-1], ((c.agent_id=a and c.partner_id=p) or (c.partner_id=a and c.agent_id=p)), p non-null/non-sentinel, p!=a} and P_post similarly for c.step in [s+1,s+W]. Indicator = |P_post|/|P_pre| if |P_pre|>0; undefined if |P_pre|=0. g.title: N5 | icts_meso_layer_contact_change Layer contact-volume change around quarantine-count increase Scale: meso | Phenomenon: intervention_contact_trajectory_shift Definition: For run r and layer L, let Q_t=model_states.quarantined at step t. Let S={t: Q_t>Q_prev(t) with previous sampled step observed}. For each t in S, define C_pre(t)=mean over u in [t-W,t-1] intersect observed steps of # contacts rows with run_id=r, layer=L, step=u; C_post(t)=mean over u in [t+1,t+W] intersect observed steps of # contacts rows with run_id=r, layer=L, step=u. Indicator = median over t in S of (C_post(t)-C_pre(t)) when S and required pre/post steps exist; undefined if S is empty or no pre/post observed steps exist. g.title: N6 | icts_macro_city_contact_change_on_quarantine_increase City contact-volume change on quarantine-increase steps Scale: macro | Phenomenon: intervention_contact_trajectory_shift Definition: For run r, let C_t=# contacts rows at step t; DeltaC_t=C_t-C_{t-1}; DeltaQ_t=Q_t-Q_{t-1} from model_states.quarantined. Let A=mean{DeltaC_t: DeltaQ_t>0 and both t and t-1 are observed}; B=mean{DeltaC_t: DeltaQ_t=0 and both t and t-1 are observed}. Indicator=A-B. Undefined if A or B has no members.
